# 使用中の named volume を delete したときの文言（container 1.2.2 / 2026-08-23）
# resourceInUse（runtime.go:383）が "in use" に一致させている先
# 引き方: container volume create → その volume を持つコンテナを走らせたまま container volume delete

failed to delete volume: ["id": opossum-inuse-probe, "error": invalidArgument: "volume 'opossum-inuse-probe' is currently in use and cannot be accessed by another container, or deleted"]
Error: delete failed for one or more volumes: ["opossum-inuse-probe"]
